api.command: command(workspace,persona,action,payload,key,now) returns {workspace,result,replayed}. Root persists returned workspace with existing CAS; original never mutated, failed subcommands return no draft.
api.document: document(workspace,persona,documentId,format='html') returns {mime,body,filename}. format only xml/html. No writing/printing/network.

passive_order.orderId: existing order ID OR orderPayload, exactly one
passive_order.orderPayload: existing order_create payload, optional alternative to orderId

session_create.shipmentId: existing noncancelled/noncompleted shipment; package.orderId must match shipment.orderIds
session_create.requiredDocuments: optional unique array subset NFE_REFERENCE/CTE/MDFE; default all3. Empty only when explicitly requested as local simulation policy.

start.id: session ID; all required docs must be DEMO_AUTHORIZED

advance.id: session ID; emits bounded synthetic route position using elapsed server clock at40km/h, not teleport

gps.sequence: next integer starting1; existing equal sequence+full identical content is replay
gps.eventId: optional payload metadata; sequence is authoritative business identity

occurrence.packageKeys: nonempty unique exact keys of linked shipment
occurrence.eventId: optional stable business event identity; if omitted HTTPkey is the identity

delivery.packageKeys: nonempty unique exact keys of linked shipment
delivery.eventId: optional stable business event identity; preserve on retry

document_prepare.reference: optional text; NFE_REFERENCE mandatory and starts SIM-

document_correct.reference: corrected local ref, SIM- for NFE_REFERENCE

webhook_retry.messageId: FAILED_NO_EFFECT or DLQ only; UNKNOWN requires query

webhook_query.messageId: UNKNOWN reconciles one local ack/effect; never invokes external receiver

invariants: w.liveOperations is the sole addon state; orders/quotes/claims/POD use executeCommand and actual object IDs, not a shadow business model.
New API order is VALIDATED and planned by existing desktop domain. It is never silently attached to a different sample trip. A session derives all orders/packages from its linked shipment.
Session movement does not satisfy or bypass existing stage/label/fiscal/assignment guards. POD only succeeds when the actual shipment is at DELIVERY with eligible keys.

Accepted GPS, occurrence and POD atomically enqueue automatic local outbox notifications with stable eventId/correlation and domain references. Limit100 can reject the whole event, never leave a partial claim/POD.

Same persona/key plus changed action/content conflicts; same business inbox/event/externalId under new HTTPkey dedups or conflicts by original canonical content. Active persona is resolved before replay.
No arbitrary URL, network, secret, GPS hardware, fiscal provider or payment involved. Public personas are not enterprise authentication.

Fiscal docs have local DRAFT/REJECTED/CORRECTED/DEMO_AUTHORIZED/CANCELLED/CLOSED_DEMO states. XML root LinceSyntheticDocument embeds escaped synthetic snapshot JSON; never SEFAZ namespace/schema or a legal authorization.
No changes to authorized docs after session start. Rejection/correction/rejection history remains; close MDFE only after linked shipment POD completes session.

timeAndLimits.acceptedTime: UTC exact milliseconds Z, valid calendar, no Date normalization
timeAndLimits.note: Root workspace serialized size/CAS limits still apply; these are simulation design bounds, not capacity/SLA claims.

visibility: Existing public persona chosen by choosePersona; pure-driver lists only sessions attached to that driver's current shipment and dependent documents/messages. Other public fictitious personas retain the existing broad simulation inspection model. Action capability checks are explicit local demo guards; not security campaign evidence.
